craft_notes: Sthāyin: exultation in the raising (mantra on breath). Sanskrit first: breath (practiced exhale), speech (mantra), vision (awakened, staff-straight, supreme) → L4 sets breath+speech line 1, vision line 2. Rows: row 2 (the vision kept whole line 2 — awake/straight/Goddess uncut). Rupture: semicolon after 'seed' — utterance done, seeing starts. Close: end-weight on the epithet ('indeed' seals daṇḍavat's fork — erect, resolved). Minimal pass: 'the seed' for mantra (seed-syllable singable, same thing). Read aloud: line 1 breathes out (practiced/speak), line 2 stands up (awake/straight/indeed). Rejected: 'prostrate' reading — killed at L0 (raising context); 'chant' for samuccaret — killed: utter keeps the exhale's plain force.

lines: Breathe out the practiced breath, and speak the seed;
see her awake, straight as a staff — the Goddess indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: juṣadrecakavṛttyā tu mantraṃ caiva samuccaret / prabuddhāṃ cintayecchaktiṃ daṇḍavat parameśvarīm

reads_against.argmap: On the exhale utter mantra and contemplate her awakened, risen rod-straight as Supreme Goddess.
c1_essence: Mantra on the exhale; her contemplated awakened, straight as a staff.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
